trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru, MC No.6475/2019
case_name: Smt. Nagamani @ Geetha M.K vs Sri. Ramu V
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife filed a petition under Section 13(1)(ia) & (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 seeking dissolution of marriage on the ground of cruelty and desertion. The trial court allowed the petition. This appeal is against that judgment.

legal_principles.principle: A settlement arrived between the parties can be a valid basis for withdrawal of allegations.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, both the parties have agreed to withdraw the allegations made against each other.

legal_principles.principle: A party's consent to a divorce judgment can be a valid basis for granting the divorce.
legal_principles.held: The appellant gave the consent for divorce judgment passed by the Prl Family Court at Bangalore in MC No.6475/2019 dated 30-11-2021.

outcome.final_order: The parties arrived at an amicable settlement, and the appellant-wife agreed to receive total permanent alimony of Rs.11,00,000/- from the respondent-husband as full and final settlement.

use_for_drafting: drafting divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act
